changes.title: Discovered by Atlas
changes.summary: Nirmal Purja first entered the public knowledge record with source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Avalanche in Pakistan kills famed mountaineer Nirmal Purja and his fellow climbers
changes.summary: A mountaineering team with climbers from around the world, including the U.S., was attempting to climb one of the tallest peaks on earth. (Image credit: Niranjan Shrestha).

changes.title: Nirmal Purja, Renowned Mountaineer, Is Found Dead After Pakistan Avalanche
changes.summary: The British-Nepali mountaineer was one of 10 climbers who were struck by an avalanche on Thursday on Broad Peak, one of the world’s highest mountains.

changes.title: Famed climber Nirmal Purja among 10 climbers killed after Pakistan avalanche, officials say
changes.summary: The 10-person expedition lost contact with its base camp after an avalanche struck Broad Peak as they attempted to scale the mountain.

changes.title: Search Continues for 7 Missing Climbers After Pakistan Avalanche
changes.summary: Three bodies, including that of an American climber, from a group of 10 were recovered a day after the avalanche struck on Thursday, officials said. The fate of renowned mountaineer Nirmal Purja was still unclear.
